selection_policy: Ten purposively chosen distinct model families and language/learning features; use their existing catalogue starter source, with no filtering by hints, baseline success, or distance. Selection fixed before reading selected baseline outputs. Not a random or population-representative sample.
review_policy: Deterministic hint information; no paid portal-Luna generation. Independent GPT-6 Luna agents review supplied public hints; not human learners.

cases.selection_rationale: Quantified implication and teacher/student role restrictions
cases.description: Every tutoring link goes from a teacher to a student. No tutoring links are required to exist.
cases.learner_body: all p,pp: Person | p->pp in Tutors implies p in Teacher

cases.selection_rationale: Relational transpose, restriction, and at-most-one multiplicity
cases.description: Each teacher teaches at most one class; teaching no classes is allowed.

cases.selection_rationale: Ternary grade relation and per-person/per-course multiplicity
cases.description: Each person has at most one grade in each course. Having no grade is allowed.
cases.learner_body: all s : Student, c : Course | lone s.(c.grades)

cases.selection_rationale: Nested quantifiers, distinctness, identifiers, and per-user context
cases.description: Within any user's profile, two distinct works supplied by the same source must not share an identifier.
cases.learner_body: all s: Source | all disj id1, id2: ((source.s) & User.profile).ids | id1 != id2

cases.selection_rationale: Transitive closure and exclusion of directed cycles
cases.description: There must be no directed cycles: no node may reach itself by following one or more edges.

cases.selection_rationale: Ternary transitions and determinism for each state/event
cases.description: For any state and event, there may be at most one destination state for a transition with that event. An event need not be enabled at every state.
cases.learner_body: all s:State, s1:State, e:Event | lone e->s1

cases.selection_rationale: Quantifier domain, join direction, and exactly-one assignment
cases.description: Every component must be assigned to exactly one workstation.
cases.learner_body: all m:Material | m in Component  => one workstation.m

cases.selection_rationale: Two-hop relational navigation, set exclusions, and equality
cases.description: A user's suggested users must be exactly the users followed by someone that user follows, excluding the user themselves and anyone they already follow.
cases.learner_body:
all u1, u2 : User | (u2 not in Influencer and u2 not in u1.follows and u2 in u1.^follows and u1 != u2) implies u2 in u1.suggested
all u1 : User | u1 not in u1.suggested

cases.selection_rationale: Integer cardinality and both directions of an equivalence
cases.description: A track must be a junction exactly when it has at least two immediate predecessors.
cases.learner_body: all t: Track | t in Junction implies #succs.t > 1

cases.selection_rationale: Temporal scope: present-state existence versus always
cases.description: At every state, at least one file must exist.
